contexts.text: There came an escaper, and told Abram the Hebrew () = that the Lord perceived from His interior man.

To a great escape () = deliverance from damnation... They who receive these goods and truths... escape damnation, and are among the residue. Hence it is that escape is mentioned in the Word passim where residues and remains are mentioned. Illustrated... From these places it is evident what to escape signifies; namely, that those who escape are those who have remains; and that to escape = to be delivered from damnation.
It shall eat the residue of that which is escaped, which is left unto you from the hail () = the consumption of all things that have anything from truth.
Hell, whence there is no escape. Signified.
There was no escaper and residue () = no good and truth.
They shall not have a residue or one escaping () = that nothing whatever of truth and good will remain.
